neighbours.label: ingredients and pairings in a savoury dinner-menu description (roast with herbs, a glass of wine), as opposed to sweet/dessert lines
fire: Tonight's main is slow-roast pork belly served with sage, apple and a cider gravy.
Set menu: three courses with a glass of chilled Spanish red wine for twenty pounds.
A hearty stew of chickpeas and roasted squash with toasted cumin and yogurt.
Braised beef cheeks served with thyme, shallots and a rich red wine sauce.
Our Sunday lunch includes a glass of crisp local rosé and a cheese course.
Pan-fried hake on a bed of leeks with capers, parsley and brown butter.
Roast duck breast served with cherries, star anise and a port reduction.
Grilled lamb chops with mint, charred peppers and a glass of house Rioja.
quiet: Tonight's dessert is warm chocolate brownie served with vanilla ice cream.
Breakfast menu: porridge with sliced banana, golden syrup and a dash of milk.
A sweet tart of glazed apricots and almond cream dusted with icing sugar.
Afternoon tea is scones topped with clotted cream and strawberry jam.
The new van comes with a roof rack, a tow bar and alloy wheels.
Our suite includes a balcony with a view over the old town square.
The children's party bag comes with balloons, stickers and a small toy.
A fruit salad of mango and pineapple with a squeeze of lime and honey.

notes: Card: peaks on ' with', ' and', ' includes' in menus; + side savoury (peas with mint, pumpkin seed oil, cabbage, English sparkling wine), - side fresh fruit/cream. Probe: 'Roast lamb served with rosemary, garlic and a red wine jus' 0.55 (peak ' wine'), 'lunch includes a glass of local white wine' 0.47, lentil/beetroot salad 0.35, salmon with dill 0.20. Dessert 0.09, smoothie 0.14, car/hotel 'with' <=0.10. Fire items lean on roast + herbs + wine; quiet items are sweet menus and non-food 'comes with/includes'.
